description: Canonical short names for every conjecture in the corpus, of the form PREFIX_english_name. PREFIX identifies the corpus (OPG: openproblemgarden.org, AX: arXiv-extracted, BM: Bondy–Murty Appendix A, OTH: others); english_name is a few lowercase words giving the gist of the statement. Names are unique across all corpora. Slight variants of one statement share a leading stem and differ by a trailing qualifier. The `id` column is the pre-existing identifier (OPG slug, arXiv review id <arxiv_id>__<NN>, Bondy–Murty bm_id, or others id), which stays the key for files, URLs and sibling repositories.
